name: Cable Bent-Over Reverse Fly
steps: Stand centered between two low cable pulleys, grip the opposite handle in each hand so the cables cross, and hinge forward with a flat back.
Soften your knees, brace your core, and set a slight bend in both elbows beneath your chest.
Sweep both arms wide out to your sides until your upper arms align with your back, squeezing your rear delts.
Guide the handles slowly back down beneath your chest without letting the weight stacks bang.
tips: Hold your hinged torso angle steady rather than rising upright as your arms open.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears throughout the fly.
